about: Questions asked in both Develop and Graph (Ed, 2026-09-28: "is the assistant context aware if the user is in Adjustments or Node graph? that would matter a lot of the directions being given"), each with the guide chapters its answer needs in each workspace (null: the question means nothing there). An entry that is a list is satisfied by any one of its chapters. `selected` is the graph's selection when asked (node types). The workspace test (src/__tests__/assistantwhere.test.tsx) runs the local ranking over the real guide in each workspace; src/__tests__/assistantroute.live.test.ts asks the routing call, by hand only.
